VTex List Seller Commissions by seller ID

params.name: accountName
params.description: Name of the VTEX account that belongs to the marketplace. The notification will be posted into this account.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment to use. Used as part of the URL.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: A string that identifies the seller in the marketplace. This ID must be created by the marketplace and informed to the seller before the integration is built.

items.docs:
This endpoint retrieves all comissions configured for a specific seller. It is not necessary to send a request body.

## Permissions

Any user or [application key](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/api-authentication-using-application-keys) must have at least one of the appropriate [License Manager resources](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/license-manager-resources--3q6ztrC8YynQf6rdc6euk3) to be able to successfully run this request.
